citations.claim: NS still in yellow (2s elapsed, need 6s) just before emergency, EW red
first violation: EW approaches turned green after 0s all-red (need 1s) due to emergency at same step
NS green before yellow phase, showing normal cycle would need yellow + all-red before EW green

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (t=51, E) – otherwise identical steps/green/yellow/all_red. Without emergency preemption, the cycle completes full 6s yellow and 1s all-red and no all_red_clearance violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=51 interrupts the normal cycle without respecting yellow/all-red. At step 48 NS is green, steps 49-50 NS is yellow (only 2s of required 6s), then at step 51 the controller immediately switches to EW green to serve the emergency on E, with 0s of all-red (need 1s). The emergency handler appears to force the demanded direction green instantly, bypassing the required yellow completion and all-red clearance insertion.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 1 s)

vision_note: At step 48 one direction shows green while the cross direction is red, steps 49-50 show the same direction on yellow, and at step 51 the opposite direction is abruptly green. No frame shows both directions red for clearance and the yellow lasts only two frames before the opposing green appears.
